scope: trusted product-baseline definitions with audio signals
principles: The silent preset is a complete visual; audio adds choreography instead of repairing the base look.
Low, mid, high and onset control different visual dimensions.
Audio does not drive the global effect amount or replace the source image.
Sustained energy changes structure or motion smoothly; onset creates a short local accent.
Every mapping is bounded by the authored parameter range and the shared Audio Response master.

choreography.low: Dot bodies breathe without changing the print screen.
choreography.mid: Source-tone contrast opens and closes smoothly.
choreography.high: Fine screen density arrives with upper-frequency detail.
choreography.onset: A short screen-angle accent passes through the separated inks.
choreography.spatial_scope: Per-dot CMY structure; never full-frame brightness.
choreography.strong_input_limit: The source silhouette and three-colour print remain readable.
